name: [🚀 SPACE] roll the world 🌎
desc:
🚀 NEW: space! make your 6th star (size 300) to leave earth, then roll up the planets, the sun, the stars and the whole universe 🌌

👍 use code 1000LIKES in the shop for 5 star spins + 3 growth potions + 2x luck for 30 min!
>> 2000 likes for a new code!

anything smaller than you sticks to your ball. the bigger you get, the bigger the stuff you can roll up.

🌱 start tiny in the grass with the bugs
🐄 roll up cows, cars and whole streets
🏙️ eat the city and everything that used to chase you
💎 find golden, diamond and rainbow finds, and even rarer ones
⭐ make stars to start over stronger

🌙 day and night, seasons and events like meteor showers and eruptions
🏆 leaderboards for stars, fastest runs and rarest finds

👥 join the overzeer group for +10% growth and the overzeer eye skin!

🎮 supports pc, mobile and console

🎃 halloween till nov 9: zombie nights, pumpkins and haunted finds

llm.loop: roll a ball that sticks smaller objects -> grow bigger -> roll up bigger stuff (cows, cities, planets) -> make a star to restart stronger
llm.objectives: grow your ball until you roll up the planets, the sun and the universe
llm.progression: ball size, stars (rebirths), stardust, rare finds tiers, space zone
llm.instructions: anything smaller than you sticks to your ball; get bigger to roll bigger stuff; make stars to start over stronger
unique: Katamari Damacy-style roll-up on Roblox, scaling from bugs to the universe
llm.thumbnails: giant smiley-faced ball covered in objects rolling over a city and through space next to Earth
llm.complexity_notes: physics rolling with object attachment at many scales, multiple zones, events and day/night
